newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp may merge at $7 per share.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp may merge at $7 per share.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Monday that it is conducting merger talks that could result in the acquisition of the the company at a price of $7.00 per share, cash. The company did not disclose the identity of the potential buyer.
The sale, said the company, contemplates resolution of the Company's insolvent property and casualty subsidiary.
PCA said it had 38,837,657 shares outstanding as of March 31. The company's stock closed Friday, May 30, at 7-1/8.
PCA provides comprehensive health care services through its Health maintenance organizations in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.
